name: ctx10k
hypothesis: PREDICTION (a feasible limit; the baseline's peak input per run has median 8.5k and p90 20.7k tokens, so the 7000-token threshold is crossed in roughly half of the runs): at most 1-2 summary compactions per affected run, compaction always brings the input back below the threshold (no `compaction_floor` events), mean steps within 20% of the baseline, and a pass rate within 10 points of 90%. A larger drop, concentrated in `tests_failed_after_edit` on runs that compacted, would be real evidence of information lost in summaries.
